questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word and the focal element)?
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the bold is reused
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, speaker labels) or on this computer (free, no speaker labels)?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, reviews, screenshots?
What is your YouTube channel called, and what is its link?
Where do the raw recordings and clean cuts of your videos live (no captions, graphics or music burned in)? I look there before downloading anything.
Do your published videos have captions or music burned into them?
(do not ask unless their disk is short of space) where downloaded videos are kept
How many clips at most from one video? I keep every clip that clears the bar, up to this number.
Which versions do you want of each clip: horizontal 16:9, vertical 9:16, or both?
Swearing stays in the audio. In the captions: starred (f***) or written as spoken?
After I have written the clip list and the editing prompts, should I stop and ask before building, or build everything and report?
Music or sound effects on these clips, or just the video's own sound?
Should clips point back to the full video (a small title tag or an end card)?
Where should finished clips go? Beside the video is the default.
Do you ever clip other people's videos? The default is that I stop and ask you each time.
Is there anything that must never be clipped: topics, names, sponsors, old offers?
